meta.description: Hire AI agents and expert reviewers, and get verified results with the evidence behind them.

nav.signedInAs: Signed in as the demo operator
nav.demoTooltip: Orders and customers are synthetic, billing and payouts are simulated, and Shopify and Stripe are sandbox mocks.
nav.demoBadge: Demo workspace: synthetic data, simulated billing

palette.title: Find anything
palette.placeholder: Find pages, runs, packs and tasks
palette.empty: Nothing matches. Try a run ID such as run_1047, or a pack name.

inspector.threeRecords: Three separate records. The evaluator only recommends; policy decides what is allowed; a person or approval signs off.
inspector.noScore: No confidence score is shown. Scores never authorize an action.

canvas.nodeHelp: Press Enter to see this step's details beside the canvas.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search runs by title, pack, ID or result
list.outcomeTooltip: Four separate marks, in order: executed, verified, accepted, settlement eligible. One can be done while another is not.
list.footer: Outcome marks, in order: executed, verified, accepted, settlement eligible. One can be done while another is not. Costs are simulated.

view.canvasHelp: Select a step, or an event in the timeline, to see who did it, what it cost and the records behind it. Drag to see the rest of the workflow.
view.deliverablePending: The deliverable appears here once the run is verified. <example>See a finished example</example>.

receipt.title: Work receipt
receipt.help: Every step is recorded in a hash chain. The versions below are the exact definitions this run used.

evidence.contractValue: <mono>{ref}</mono>: every order matched to a payout, exceptions reviewed by a person, totals verified to the cent.
evidence.permitted: What was permitted, and what changed outside New Machines
evidence.permittedBody: Google Sheets was read twice, read-only. No sheet, email or file was changed by this run.
evidence.permittedNote: The report is a draft in New Machines. Filing it to Drive needs your approval.
evidence.basisValue: Verified by the independent check and accepted by you. Reviewer pay was owed from the moment the submission was accepted.

errors.unreachable: Can't reach New Machines. Check your connection and retry.
errors.contract: New Machines sent data this page did not expect. Reload to try again.

notFound.title: There is nothing at this address
notFound.body: The run, pack or task may have a different ID, or the link is incomplete.

signIn.mismatch: That email and password did not match. Check them and try again.
signIn.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
signIn.offline: Can't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.googleIncomplete: Google sign-in did not finish. Try again.

landing.headline: Work you can check before you pay for it.
landing.lede: Agents handle routine operations such as order reconciliation and refund triage. When a call needs judgement, a vetted reviewer makes it. An independent check verifies the result, and nothing is paid until you accept it.
landing.recordLink: See each step and who took it
landing.signInTitle: Sign in to the demo workspace
landing.signInHelp: Use the login you were given, or any Google account.
landing.footerNote: Not indexed. Customers, orders and reviewers here are made up, and no money moves.
landing.footerBuilt: Built for the <cup>AI Builder Cup</cup>, December 2026.

signIn.mockNote: Sign-in is simulated. No credentials are checked.
signIn.joinNote: You join Harbor & Pine Supply Co. as a paying member. Reviewers sign in here too and switch to the reviewer portal from the workspace menu.

record.title: Yesterday’s reconciliation at Harbor & Pine
record.intro: {title}. 38 minutes of work, {total} all in. Every line below comes from the run’s record.
record.afterVerified: The agent’s own claim of success was not used.
record.afterAccepted: One order waits on Tuesday’s payout. It stays tracked, not hidden.

overview.outcomeMarks: Outcome marks: executed, verified, accepted, settlement eligible

ask.label: What work do you want done?
ask.placeholder: What work do you want done? Describe the outcome, for example “reconcile orders and payouts every week”

suggestions.reconcile: Match last week's orders to Stripe payouts
suggestions.invoices: Chase wholesale invoices that are past due
suggestions.refunds: Handle refund requests from support email
suggestions.reorder: Tell me what to reorder every Monday
suggestions.translate: Translate our catalog for a Japanese store

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lede: When policy needs your sign-off, you approve one exact action. If anything in it changes, the approval no longer applies and you are asked again.

card.approvedToastBody: One email to {to}. Simulated: nothing leaves the demo.
card.declinedToastBody: Nothing was sent. The run closes this invoice as skipped.
card.emailHeading: The email, exactly as it will be sent
card.subject: Subject
card.pendingNote: Approving sends this one email once. Editing the draft or the recipient would need a new approval.
card.approvedTitle: Approved. The run will send the email and confirm it in Gmail's Sent folder.
card.declinedBody: The run will close this invoice as skipped.
card.simulatedNote: Runs against sandbox data. Nothing changes in {app}.
card.actionPendingNote: Approving lets the run take this one step. Declining stops the run.
card.actionApprovedToastBody: The run goes on with this step in {app}.
card.actionApprovedToastSimulated: The run goes on with this step. Simulated: nothing changes in {app}.
card.actionDeclinedToastBody: The run stops here. Nothing was changed in {app}.
card.actionApprovedTitle: Approved. The run goes on with this step.
card.actionDeclinedBody: Nothing was changed in {app}. Start a new run to try again.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lede: Connect an app once. Each hired pack then gets only the access you grant it. The app's own sign-in permissions and the grants below are separate, and you can revoke either one.

connect.title: Connect an app
connect.description: New Machines sends you to the app's own sign-in page through Composio. You approve the permissions there, and we never see your password.
connect.demoNote: This demo workspace cannot connect real accounts. Google Sheets, Gmail and Drive are already connected to a test account.

connections.disconnectedToastBody: Packs that used it will ask before running again. Simulated in this demo.
connections.notConnectedNote: Not connected. Packs that need {app} will ask before they use it.
connections.disconnectDescription: Every hired pack loses access to {app} at once. Runs that need it will stop and ask you before going on.
connections.grantsHeading: What each hired pack may do
connections.revokeDescription: {install} will no longer be able to use {capability} on {app}. You can grant it again from the pack's settings.

memory.title: Memory
memory.lede: What your agents have learned about how your business works. Nothing becomes memory until a person approves it, and your systems of record always win over memory.
memory.none: No memories in use. Agents rely only on your systems of record.
memory.retractedToastBody: Agents stop using it from their next run.

candidate.title: Waiting for your decision
candidate.approvedToastBody: The Finance Agent will use it from its next run.
candidate.rejectedToastBody: Agents will not use it. It stays in the history.
candidate.conflict: Conflicts with a memory already in use
candidate.conflictNote: Approving the new one marks <mono>{id}</mono> as corrected for weekend orders.
candidate.pendingNote: Until you decide, agents can see this proposal but may not act on it. <run>run_1047</run> sent a weekend order to a reviewer for exactly this reason.
candidate.editDescription: Agents follow the wording exactly. Keep it to one rule, and say when it applies.
candidate.approvedTitle: Approved. The Finance Agent will use this from its next run.
candidate.approvedBody: You can retract it from the list of memories in use.
candidate.rejectedTitle: Rejected. Agents will not use it.

row.usedIn: Used in {n, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
row.retractDescription: Agents stop using it from their next run. Runs already finished keep the record of what they used.

grid.intro: Workflow Packs bundle agents, the reviewers they need and the checks that prove the work. Try any pack on sample data before you hire it.
grid.priceNote: Prices are estimates per run. You only pay reviewers when a run needs one.
grid.searchPlaceholder: Search packs by outcome, publisher or category

trial.title: Try it in the sandbox
trial.intro: Runs the pack on synthetic data. Your real connections are not used, and any write is stopped before it leaves the sandbox.

recon.read: Read 20 synthetic orders and 19 payout lines (sample sheet, read-only)
recon.retail: Retail Agent: 20 orders inspected, 1 refund noted
recon.decision: Decision: 2 records need a person (reference mismatch, payout not found)
recon.blocked: Blocked in sandbox: “File report to Drive”. Writes are inert in trials

generic.done: Agents completed the task on the sample
generic.inert: All writes were inert. Nothing left the sandbox

pack.passportIntro: Tested on {date} by {by}, on {n} record batches from: {cohort}. These numbers describe that sample only.
pack.refreshing: The evaluation report for this pack is being refreshed.
pack.uncertifiedNote: Not yet certified. The publisher's own claims have not been tested by New Machines. Try it in the sandbox first.
pack.basisValue: Charged only for verified work. Reviewer pay is owed once a submission is accepted.
pack.publisherSeesValue: Aggregate quality numbers only. Never your data or runs.

install.lede: Check what this pack will be allowed to do before you hire it. You can change any of this later, and nothing runs until you start it.
install.hiredBody: Pinned to version {version}. It will not update without asking you. Start a run from home, or let it run on a schedule.
install.writeWithApproval: Can write, but only after you approve each action
install.capabilitiesNote: Requesting a capability does not grant it. Each action is checked against your policies when it happens.
install.capNote: A run stops and asks you before it would go past this amount, including reviewer pay.
install.poolLabel: Use the New Machines invoice reviewer pool (US and Philippines). Reviewers see only the records they are asked about, with customer names and emails hidden, for the length of the task.
install.poolNote: Policy human_review@4 still requires a person for payment mismatches, whatever you choose here.
install.agree: I agree to the work contract and pay terms for this pack.
install.contractDescription: The short version. The full contract is versioned and pinned with the pack.

contract.pay: You pay for agent and tool use as it happens, up to the cap you set per run.
contract.delivered: A result counts as delivered only after an independent check passes. If the check fails, the run is not charged for the result.
contract.reviewers: Reviewers are paid for accepted submissions even when a later step fails. New Machines covers that pay when the failure is ours.
contract.data: Your data stays in {regions}. Reviewers see only redacted records, only during their task.
contract.updates: Updates to the pack never apply until you approve them. You can stop using it at any time.

list.lede: The agents that do the work inside Workflow Packs. One agent can serve several packs.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search agents by name, publisher, summary or capability
list.usedIn: {n, plural, =0 {Not in a pack yet} one {Used in # pack} other {Used in # packs}}

detail.sampleNote: A sample agent from the demo workspace. Its skills and tools are not published.
detail.capabilitiesNote: What the agent asks to do. Every action is still checked against your policies.
detail.noTools: None. It works only from the data the pack gives it.
detail.notUsed: No Workflow Pack uses this agent yet.

new.title: Start a run
new.lede: Choose a hired pack and the data it should work on. You can stop the run at any time.
new.needInput: Connect an app with this data first.
new.notHired: {name} isn't hired yet, so it can't start a run.

startRun.needInput: Connect an app with this data first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Who can use this workspace, the rules every run follows, and access for AI tools like Gemini and Antigravity CLI.

policies.title: Policies
policies.note: A blocked action has no override button. To allow it, change the policy here, and the change is recorded.

members.title: Members
members.inviteDescription: They get an email link and sign in with Google or an email and password.
members.taken: This person is already in the workspace or invited.

roleHelp.Member: Starts runs and approves actions their policy allows.
roleHelp.Admin: Also changes policies, connections and billing.

members.sentToastBody: {address} can join as {role} once they accept. Simulated in this demo.

tokens.title: Access for AI tools (MCP)
tokens.createTitle: Create a token for an AI tool
tokens.createDescription: The token works for 30 days. It can never approve or decline anything, whatever you choose here.
tokens.name: Name

scope.approvals:list: See what is waiting for approval

tokens.lede: Let Gemini, Antigravity CLI or another AI tool list your packs, start runs and see what is waiting. Tokens can never approve or decline anything.
tokens.createdToastBody: In the live product you copy the full token once, right here. Demo tokens do not work.
tokens.revokedToastBody: {name} can no longer reach this workspace.
tokens.revokeDescription: The tool loses access at once. Runs it already started keep going.
tokens.none: No tokens. Create one to connect Gemini or another AI tool.

usage.title: Usage and billing
usage.lede: Every charge comes from a recorded run step and is posted twice: once against your account and once against where the money goes. In this demo no money moves.
usage.heldNote: Released when <run>run_1047</run> finishes. Only what it uses is charged.
usage.agentsToolsNote: Metered per run step. The {plan} plan and reviewer pay are counted separately.
usage.reviewerPayNote: {n} tasks. {absorbed} of it was absorbed by New Machines after a failed verification.
usage.ledgerNote: Each entry balances: debits equal credits
usage.includesValue: Unlimited hired packs, 5 members, 30-day run history
usage.paymentValue: None. This demo workspace never charges a card.

work.lede: Paid review work that matches your skills. You see the pay, the time it should take and the data rules before you claim anything.
work.simulatedPay: Pay is simulated in this demo
work.paidOnAccept: Paid once your submission is accepted

how.title: How claiming works
how.body: Claiming gives you a lease on the task. If the lease runs out before you submit, the task goes back to the queue. Buyer names stay hidden, and confidential records arrive redacted.

earnings.lede: You are paid for every accepted submission, including when you reject the agent's work or a later step fails.
earnings.simulated: No real payouts in this demo
earnings.failedCheck: The run failed its independent check after your review. Your pay is unaffected.

task.holdRanOutLive: Your hold ran out. The task went back to the queue so another reviewer can claim it. You can no longer submit this review.
task.lessThanFive: Less than 5 minutes left on your hold.

expired.title: Your hold ran out, so the task went back to the queue
expired.body: Another reviewer can claim it now, and this review can no longer be submitted. Claim it again to start a fresh hold if it is still open. In this demo it always is.

claimed.title: Claimed
claimed.body: Your hold lasts up to {n} min from when you claimed it. Submit before it ends.

closed.title: This task is no longer available
closed.body: It was closed or cancelled, so it cannot be claimed or submitted.

validating.title: Submitted. Checking that it is complete…
validating.body: Your answers are being validated against the task’s form.

submitted.title: Submitted. Waiting for the check to finish
submitted.body: Your review is in. Pay is owed once it is accepted.

accepted.title: Accepted. {pay} is owed to you.
accepted.body: Your pay is owed now, whatever happens in later steps. The run resumes from its checkpoint with your corrections, and the steps that already finished do not run again.
accepted.runNote: In the business workspace, this shows up on <run>{id}</run>. Your access to the records has ended.

offer.timeValue: About {est} minutes. You hold the task for up to {lease} minutes.
offer.dataConfidential: Confidential order and payment records, with customer details hidden
offer.owedNote: Owed as soon as your submission is accepted, even if a later step fails.
offer.demoOnly: Only the reconciliation task can be claimed in this demo.

lease.label: {mm} minutes {ss} seconds left on your hold
lease.warn: left on your hold, submit soon

REVISION_REQUIRED.label: Send back with corrections
REVISION_REQUIRED.help: The agent should apply your notes and try again.
REVISION_REQUIRED.helpRun: Your corrections go to the next step of the run. The agent does not redo its work.

REJECTED.label: Reject
REJECTED.help: The result is wrong and should not be retried.
REJECTED.helpRun: The result is wrong. The run stops here and does not retry.

ESCALATED.label: Escalate
ESCALATED.help: This needs someone with more authority or context.
ESCALATED.helpRun: Needs someone with more authority or context. The run stops here.

feedback.label: Feedback for the agent
feedback.help: Plain language. If it holds in general, it may be proposed as a memory for the business to approve.
feedback.placeholder: For example: weekend orders are paid out on Tuesday, so a missing Monday payout is pending, not missing.
feedback.expired: Your hold ran out. Claim the task again to submit.
feedback.incomplete: Decide on every record and write at least a sentence of feedback.

runSubmitted.continuesTitle: Review recorded. The run goes on with it.
runSubmitted.continuesBody: The next step uses your verdict and corrections.
runSubmitted.stopsTitle: Review recorded. The run stops here.
runSubmitted.stopsBody: You rejected or escalated the result, so the run ends without retrying.
